description: End-to-end lifecycle management for Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) resources including virtual networks, connections, QoS policies, and provisioning workflows.

tenant_id.description: Identifier for the tenant or customer account

network_id.description: Identifier for a provisioned virtual network

connection_id.description: Identifier for a logical connection (e.g., site-to-site, cloud on-ramp)

qos_policy_id.description: Identifier for a defined QoS policy

provisioning_request_id.description: Identifier for an asynchronous provisioning request or workflow

location_id.description: Identifier for a physical or logical POP/region/availability zone

error_object.description: Standard error structure used across functions

retryable.description: Indicates if the operation can be safely retried

endpoint_spec.description: Generic definition of an endpoint participating in a network or connection

location_id.description: Location/POP/region where the endpoint is anchored

ipv4_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR block advertised from this endpoint

ipv6_cidr.description: IPv6 CIDR block advertised from this endpoint

nat_mode.description: NAT behavior applied to this endpoint

bandwidth_mbps.description: Committed bandwidth for this endpoint in Mbps

required.description: Whether HA is required for this endpoint

min_links.description: Minimum number of links for redundancy

functions.name: discover_network_capabilities
functions.description: Discover available NaaS capabilities, locations, and resource limits for a tenant.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow discovery results

capability_types.description: Limit results to specific capability types

regions.description: Filter by regions or POP locations

functions.returns: List of available capabilities, supported locations, and optional tenant-specific quotas and limits.

functions.name: check_network_resource_availability
functions.description: Check resource and capacity availability for a proposed network design before provisioning.

endpoints.description: List of endpoints to be connected in the network

topology.description: Desired logical topology of the network

qos_profile.description: High-level QoS requirements for the network

priority_classes.description: Abstract traffic classes with latency and loss expectations

encryption_required.description: Whether traffic must be encrypted end-to-end

requested_start_time.description: When the network is expected to become active

functions.returns: Feasibility assessment with capacity availability per location, estimated SLAs, and potential constraints or required design changes.

functions.name: create_virtual_network
functions.description: Create a new virtual network design and initiate provisioning.

endpoints.description: Endpoints to attach to this network

hub_definition.description: Mandatory if topology is hub_spoke or partial_mesh

internet_breakout.description: Internet breakout policy for the hub

qos_policy_id.description: Reference to an existing QoS policy to apply globally

auto_approve.description: If false, network is created in pending_approval state

functions.returns: Network creation result including network_id, provisioning_request_id, initial state, and any pending approvals.

functions.name: get_network_details
functions.description: Retrieve details of a virtual network including endpoints, policies, and current operational status.

include.description: Control which additional sections to return

functions.returns: Complete network object including configuration, state, attached connections, policies, and optionally metrics and events.

functions.name: list_networks
functions.description: List virtual networks for a tenant with optional filtering and pagination.

tag_selector.description: Match networks with specific tag values

functions.returns: Paged list of networks with summary information and pagination cursors.

functions.name: define_qos_policy
functions.description: Create or update a QoS policy that can be attached to networks or individual connections.

qos_policy_id.description: If provided, updates existing policy; otherwise creates new

classes.description: Traffic classes with bandwidth and priority mappings

traffic_matchers.description: Match rules that map traffic into this class

default_class_name.description: Name of the class used for unmatched traffic

functions.returns: QoS policy definition including qos_policy_id, validation results, and effective class ordering.

functions.name: create_connection
functions.description: Create a logical connection between two or more endpoints, optionally within an existing network.

network_id.description: If provided, the connection is scoped within this virtual network

qos_policy_id.description: Override QoS policy for this specific connection

sla_profile.description: Explicit SLA parameters for this connection

maintenance_window.description: Preferred maintenance window for changes to this connection

auto_activate.description: If false, connection is provisioned but left in disabled state

functions.returns: Connection creation result including connection_id, optional network_id association, and provisioning_request_id.

functions.name: get_provisioning_status
functions.description: Get the current status and history of an asynchronous provisioning request.
functions.returns: Provisioning request status including phase, progress, associated resources (network_id, connection_id), and any error_object if failed.

functions.name: update_network_configuration
functions.description: Modify configuration of an existing virtual network, including endpoints and attached QoS policies.

remove_endpoint_location_ids.description: Endpoints to remove, referenced by location_id

tags.description: Tags to upsert or remove (null/empty string to remove key)

dry_run.description: If true, validates and returns impact without applying

functions.returns: Change plan and, if not dry_run, provisioning_request_id for applying changes, plus any validation warnings or conflicts.

functions.name: rollback_network_change
functions.description: Rollback a previous failed or undesired network change using its provisioning_request_id.

strategy.description: Full rollback or partial rollback of only failed components

preserve_new_connections.description: If true, keep any newly created connections

preserve_added_endpoints.description: If true, do not remove newly added endpoints

force.description: Force rollback even if pre-checks detect inconsistencies

functions.returns: Rollback initiation result including new provisioning_request_id for the rollback, and summary of planned revert actions.

functions.name: retry_provisioning_step
functions.description: Retry a failed or stuck step within a provisioning request, with optional override parameters.

step_id.description: Identifier of the specific step to retry; if omitted, retries the last failed step

override_parameters.description: Optional key-value overrides for the failed step input

retry_policy.description: Custom retry behavior for this invocation only

functions.returns: Updated provisioning status for the retried step and overall request, including any new error_object if retry fails.

functions.name: decommission_network
functions.description: Gracefully decommission a virtual network and all or selected associated connections.

mode.description: Whether to decommission immediately or at a scheduled time

drain_traffic.description: If true, stop accepting new flows and wait for active flows to drain

connection_handling.description: How to handle connections associated with the network

preserve_connection_ids.description: Explicit list of connections to preserve when policy is preserve_manually_marked

functions.returns: Decommission request result including provisioning_request_id and planned impact on connections and endpoints.

functions.name: bulk_import_networks
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple networks from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined networks, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_networks
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of networks matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped networks with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_networks
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of networks with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_networks
functions.description: Export a filtered set of networks to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_networks_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across networks with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with networks hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_network_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on network lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_network_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing network subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_network_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a network subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_network_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single network with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across networks for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_network_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of networks.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_network_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to networks with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of network jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_network_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight network job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_network_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a network (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_network_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive network change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_network_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a network approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_network_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a network, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_network_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a network, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_network
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a network for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_network_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a network from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_network_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over networks (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched networks.

functions.name: build_network_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over networks data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_network_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern network behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_network_policies
functions.description: List policies governing networks with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_network_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a network and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.

functions.name: get_network_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the full dependency graph for a network, with configurable depth and filtering.
functions.returns: Graph object with nodes (networks and related artefacts) and typed edges.
